name: Healing Hearts
source:
Leah (name can be changed) Parrish is in her second year at Faelands School of Magic. It is time for her to be assigned to a team of other magic-users to continue her training for the next three years. Protecting the mundane world from magical threats is a dangerous job, and her teammates are incredibly important to her future –in more ways than one. The problem: the rest of Leah's teammates are all guys, and the team lives together! On top of that, as the team's Healer she has to choose one of them to be her Primary –the one whose job it is to protect her over all else. Who will she pick?

[From [url=https://dacora.itch.io/healing-hearts-otome]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
利亚（名字可以更改）帕里什是费兰魔法学校的二年级学生。是时候让她被分配到由其他魔法使用者组成的团队中，继续她未来三年的训练了。保护世俗世界免受魔法威胁是一项危险的工作，而她的队友对她的未来极其重要——在很多方面。问题是：莉亚的其他队友都是男人，而且团队生活在一起！最重要的是，作为团队的治疗者，她必须选择其中一位作为她的主要治疗者——其职责就是保护她胜过其他一切。她会选谁呢？

[来自[url=https://dacora.itch.io/healing-hearts-otome]Itch.io[/url]]
